title: AraEngage: Interpretable Linguistic Correlates of Engagement in Arabic Facebook News
abstract: arXiv:2611.07926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Engagement features developed for English are routinely applied to Arabic, but unvocalized Arabic changes what a lexical feature measures. We introduce AraEngage, a query-defined sample of 10,000 public Arabic Facebook news posts from 2,451 pages in 57 countries (2023-2024) that pairs engagement counts with interpretable linguistic features. We use it to examine which interpretable Arabic indicators are associated with follower-normalized engagement, and how far those associations can be trusted given publisher context, the definition of engagement, and lexical ambiguity. Religious expressions, message length, sentence length, and lexical density are the leading correlates in a Random Forest model ($R^2$ = 0.38 on a post-level split) interpreted with SHAP. translated_title: AraEngage：阿拉伯语Facebook新闻中用户参与度的可解释语言学关联因素
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.07926v1 公告类型：新 摘要：为英语开发的参与度特征经常被直接应用于阿拉伯语，但未标元音的阿拉伯语改变了词汇特征所测量的内容。我们推出了AraEngage，这是一个通过查询定义的样本，包含来自57个国家2,451个页面的10,000条公开阿拉伯语Facebook新闻帖子（2023-2024年），将参与度计数与可解释的语言特征相配对。我们利用它来检验哪些可解释的阿拉伯语指标与按关注者数归一化的参与度相关，以及在考虑发布者背景、参与度定义和词汇歧义的情况下，这些关联的可信程度如何。在一个用SHAP进行解释的随机森林模型（帖子级数据划分下R²=0.38）中，宗教表达、消息长度、句子长度和词汇密度是主要的关联因素。与英语新闻不同，在这个阿拉伯语新闻样本中，积极情感与更高的参与度相关。消息长度呈现出一种长度悖论：未调整的原始参与度在……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发布了AraEngage数据集，通过可解释的机器学习分析发现宗教表达、消息长度、句子长度和词汇密度是阿拉伯语Facebook新闻参与度的主要语言学关联因素，并揭示了与英语新闻相反的积极情感效应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AraEngage, a dataset of 10,000 Arabic Facebook news posts, and identifies religious expressions, message length, sentence length, and lexical density as the leading interpretable linguistic correlates of engagement, revealing a positive sentiment effect that contrasts with English news.
